- Director 5 holds 98.34% of shares  

**Overview:** Teguh Kirana Freight Sdn. Bhd. is a private limited logistics firm that provides last‑mile parcel delivery across Kuching. It was incorporated on 6 September 1992 and is based in Pulau Pinang, Malaysia. The company’s share capital is RM 2,500,000, with the largest shareholder—a director—owning 98.34% of the equity. Revenue grew from RM 10,874,080 in 2022 to RM 21,522,626 in 2024, with unqualified audit opinions each year. Profit after tax increased from RM 431,162 in 2022 to RM 913,861 in 2024, keeping net margin near 4%.
